capabilities.summary: WCAG relative luminance, contrast ratio and readable ink on a background for sRGB colours
policyNotes: Declaration-only: apps call this crate (or RightKitUI.RightKitContrast, or @rightkit/theme) instead of hand-rolling a luminance threshold.
A luminance on gamma-encoded channels is not WCAG luminance; use is_light or readable_on.
